cards.title: Modern React Patterns
cards.description: A deep dive into compound components, render props, and custom hooks for scalable React architecture.
cards.highlight: The patterns senior engineers actually use in production.

cards.title: TypeScript Strict Mode
cards.description: Why enabling strict mode will catch bugs before they reach production and how to migrate an existing codebase.
cards.highlight: Strict mode is not optional if you care about quality.

cards.title: CSS Grid Mastery
cards.description: From basic layouts to complex magazine-style grids — everything you need to stop reaching for a framework.
cards.highlight: Native CSS is more powerful than you remember.

cards.title: Next.js App Router Deep Dive
cards.description: Server components, streaming, and the mental model shift required to build well with the App Router.
cards.highlight: The App Router demands a new way of thinking.

cards.title: Securing Your API
cards.description: Rate limiting, JWT hardening, CORS misconfiguration, and the ten mistakes most teams make with backend security.
cards.highlight: Your API is a door — make sure it locks.

cards.title: Zustand vs Redux in 2025
cards.description: A practical side-by-side comparison of global state solutions with real bundle size and DX tradeoffs.
cards.highlight: Pick the right tool, not the popular one.

cards.title: Building a Design System
cards.description: Tokens, component APIs, documentation, and the governance model that keeps a design system alive long-term.
cards.highlight: A design system is a product, not a project.

cards.title: Web Accessibility in Practice
cards.description: Beyond ARIA labels — how to audit, fix, and maintain accessibility across a production application.
cards.highlight: Accessible design is just good design.

cards.title: Testing Without Tears
cards.description: A pragmatic testing strategy using Vitest, Testing Library, and Playwright that your team will actually maintain.
cards.highlight: Tests you trust are better than tests you tolerate.

cards.title: Deploying on the Edge
cards.description: How edge runtimes, CDN caching, and regional deployments can cut your TTFB to under 50ms globally.
cards.highlight: Speed is a feature your users feel immediately.

cards.title: Mastering Tailwind CSS
cards.description: Utility-first isn't just a styling approach — it's a workflow shift. Here's how to get the most out of Tailwind v4.
cards.highlight: Stop writing CSS files, start shipping faster.

cards.title: Monorepo with Turborepo
cards.description: Structuring a scalable monorepo with shared packages, incremental builds, and a sane CI pipeline using Turborepo.
cards.highlight: One repo to rule your entire stack.
